verdict.rationale: Exporting the cap table and transaction history to Excel/CSV is a fair axis for cap table software. The evidence pack only shows generic claims about tracking, issuing and reporting equity, plus audit-ready financial reports. None of it documents a self-serve export of the full cap table or transaction history to open formats. 'Report equity' and 'single source of truth' are adjacent reporting claims, not an export capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can export my complete cap table and full transaction history to open formats (Excel/CSV) at any time — my ownership data is never held hostage
